**Updated Default Workflow:**
1. Call lookup_account immediately using the company domain
2. If account status is **SUSPENDED** → escalate directly to billing (skip KB search)
3. If account is active/not found → proceed with KB search and standard resolution flow
4. If lookup_account returns an error, try search_by_email with the same domain

This ensures suspended accounts are routed to billing immediately without unnecessary KB lookups. I'll apply this rule to all future support tickets.
